events.question: How does the credit card referral bonus program work — what are the requirements for a referral bonus to be awarded, and are there limits on how many bonuses a referrer can receive?

facts_found: Each credit card type has its own referral bonus amount and eligibility requirements; the general document does not enumerate them. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_002]

A referrer can receive at most 2 credit card referral bonuses in any rolling 7-day window; the third and any subsequent referrals in that window are automatically denied. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_002]
The 2-per-7-day cap applies across all credit card types — referrals from different cards count toward the same weekly cap. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_002]

The rolling 7-day window is evaluated on the exact timestamps of the referrer's most recent successful referral bonuses, not calendar weeks; auto-denied referrals cannot be reinstated within the same window, and the referrer must wait until older bonuses age out. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_002]

A referral bonus is earned when the referred person applies using the referrer's unique link and is approved for a new card; the bonus form varies by card (cash back, bonus points, or statement credit). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_020]

Referral links are generated by the customer in the mobile app, online banking portal, or via customer service; not all credit cards participate — the card must have an active referral offer. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_020]
Each card's program sets its own trigger requirement, typically a specified amount of purchases within a set timeframe after account opening. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_020]

Referral status REJECTED means the user has too many referral processes going on (rolling limit); COMPLETE means the criteria were met and the bonus will be granted per program terms; APPLIED means awaiting a decision; NO_PROGRESS means no application started; ERROR means a system error (retry later or escalate). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_001]

Before giving referral information the agent must confirm the specific card has a documented referral program; if none is documented, the user's stated terms don't match, or the referral would be auto-rejected, the agent explains why and does NOT provide the referral link tool (and does not transfer to a human). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_009]
Calling get_referral_link successfully creates a referral record with status NO_PROGRESS; agents must not generate the link on the customer's behalf. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_009]

Platinum Rewards Card referral: $100 per approved referral whose holder spends at least $1,500 within 90 days of account opening; up to 7 referral bonuses per calendar year; bonuses credited after approval and the spend requirement; self-referrals or duplicate applications do not qualify; referrer account should be in good standing for prompt payment. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_008]

Silver Rewards Card referral: 75 per successful referral; up to 7 referral bonuses per calendar year; referred person must be approved and spend at least $750 within 60 days of account opening; bonus typically posts within one to two billing cycles after the requirement is met. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_011]

EcoCard referral: 50 per successful referral; up to 7 referral bonuses per calendar year; referred person must be approved and spend at least $500 within 60 days; bonus typically posts within one to two billing cycles after the requirement is met. [doc_credit_cards_ecocard_011]

Business Gold Rewards Card referral: $200 per successful referral; $7,500 qualifying spend within 90 days of account opening; up to 8 referral bonuses per calendar year; self-referrals not permitted; a referral that applies without the link may not be attributed; new referrals accepted only until 2025-09-15. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_gold_rewards_card_010]

Business Platinum Rewards Card referral: $300 bonus; $15,000 qualifying spend within 135 days of account opening; up to 11 referral bonuses per calendar year; referral must be submitted before the application for attribution; credited after verification of approval and spend. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_platinum_rewards_card_012]

Business Bronze Rewards Card referral: $75 per successful referral; up to 7 per calendar year; referred business must be approved and complete at least $1,750 in net purchases within 90 days; if a referred account is closed or reversed, any unpaid referral bonus may be canceled. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_bronze_rewards_card_011]

Silver Zoom Card referral: $150 per approved logistics referral meeting $7,500 purchases within 90 days; capped at 10 per calendar year; only one referrer is credited per approved account; no bonus if the referred business returns purchases or misses the requirement; no new referrals accepted after 2025-10-01. [doc_business_credit_cards_silver_zoom_card_011]

Green Rewards Card referral: 75 per successful referral; up to 7 per calendar year; referred business must apply through the unique referral link, be approved, and spend at least $2,250 within 90 days; account must remain in good standing through the verification date; qualifying purchases exclude cash equivalents, certain fees, and returned transactions; bonus credited after verification. [doc_business_credit_cards_green_rewards_card_010]

Business Silver Rewards Card referral: $100 per successful referral; up to 10 per calendar year; referred business must spend at least $3,000 within 90 days of account opening and must apply using the referrer's details for tracking. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_013]
Referral status can be tracked in the app/referral dashboard, and customers are notified when referrals are approved and when a bonus is earned. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_020]

open_questions: No credit-card-wide posting SLA (e.g., 'within N business days') is documented; only per-card language such as 'one to two billing cycles' (Silver, EcoCard) or 'after verification' (Platinum, business cards).

No documented general credit-card eligibility restrictions analogous to the checking-account rules (new-customer requirement, same-address restriction, referrer tenure threshold, stacking restrictions, clawback) — those appear only in the checking-account referral terms docs and should not be assumed to apply to credit cards.

No documented referral programs were found for the consumer Bronze Rewards Card, Gold Rewards Card, Diamond Elite Card, or Crypto-Cash Back Card, so their bonus amounts/caps are unknown (absence of documentation means no active offer per the internal pre-check).
Whether the 2-per-7-day rolling cap and any annual card cap are enforced by a specific tool parameter is not stated in the KB.

facts_found: No internal agent tool for retrieving/inspecting a customer's credit card referral records or denial reasons is documented in the knowledge base; repeated searches returned only the customer-facing get_referral_link tool and unrelated history tools (dispute history, CLI history, closure-reason history). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_009]

get_referral_link(user_id: str, card_name: str) is the only documented referral tool; it is provided to and run by the customer, and a successful call creates a referral record with status 'NO_PROGRESS'. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_009]
Agents must not generate the referral link on the customer's behalf; the customer passes their own user_id and the exact card name. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_009]

Referral status REJECTED means the user has too many referral processes going on (i.e., the rolling limit was hit); on REJECTED the agent should not retry immediately and should review the user's existing referral activity before advising next steps. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_001]

Referral status definitions: COMPLETE = criteria met and bonus granted per program terms; IN_PROGRESS = account opened, working toward criteria; APPLIED = awaiting decision; NO_PROGRESS = no application started; ERROR = system error (retry later or escalate internally if persistent). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_001]

A customer can receive at most 2 credit card referral bonuses in any rolling 7-day window; the third and any subsequent referrals in that window are automatically denied, and the cap applies across all credit card types. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_002]
The rolling 7-day window is evaluated on the exact timestamps of the referrer's most recent successful referral bonuses, not calendar weeks. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_002]

Auto-denied referrals due to the rolling limit cannot be reinstated within the same 7-day window; the referrer must wait until enough time passes to drop under the cap (older bonuses age out) before attempting another referral. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_002]

No appeal, override, or manual-reinstatement process for credit card referral denials is documented; the only documented remedy is waiting for the rolling window to clear. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_002]

Referral status can be tracked by the customer in the Rho-Bank mobile app (referral dashboard / rewards section), and the customer is notified when referrals are approved and when a bonus is earned; agents can also field referral questions via customer service. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_020]

Before giving referral information the agent must confirm the specific card has a documented referral program; if none is documented, the user's stated terms don't match, or the referral would be auto-rejected, the agent explains why and does NOT provide the referral link tool and does not transfer to a human. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_009]

Each credit card type has its own referral bonus amount and eligibility requirements; the general credit card referral document does not enumerate them, so per-card terms must be checked in the card-specific referral documents. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_002]

For comparison, the analogous checking-account referral FAQ states rejection reasons explicitly (rolling window limit, existing/recent account, same address, same business primary owner) and directs ineligible users to wait until the oldest qualifying referral ages out of the window — but that document governs checking accounts, not credit cards. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_048]

The documented internal pattern for retrieving a per-user history list (get_user_dispute_history_7291(user_id), returning statuses, dates, reason_code, outcome, internal notes) exists for credit card disputes only; no equivalent referral-history tool is documented. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_016]

facts_found: The KB documents no internal agent tool for retrieving or inspecting a customer's credit card referral records, per-referral status, or denial reasons; searches returned only the customer-facing get_referral_link tool and unrelated history tools (dispute history, CLI/payment history, closure-reason history). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_009]

Referral status can be tracked by the customer in the Rho-Bank mobile app / referral dashboard, and the customer is notified when referrals are approved and when a bonus is earned; questions about the referral program or current card offer are directed to the customer service team (1-800-RHO-BANK). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_020]

Transfers to humans are performed with the transfer_to_human_agents tool, and the reason code must be selected from a documented 4-tier list, always choosing from the highest tier that applies. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042]
TIER 2 is labeled 'Knowledge/Capability Gap Reasons' and is to be used when the transfer is due to the agent's inability to find or verify information. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042]

The Tier 2 code kb_search_unsuccessful_customer_requests_transfer is defined as: customer asked for information or instructions that you searched for in KB but couldn't find, you informed the customer, customer then requests transfer. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042]

The Tier 2 code specialized_department_required is defined as: request requires a specialized department (mortgage, investments, business banking) outside the agent's scope of knowledge/tools. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042]
The Tier 1 code technical_system_error is defined as: system error or outage preventing completion of the customer's request. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042]
The Tier 4 catch-all code other requires a detailed explanation in the summary field. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042]

The 'do not transfer to a human' instruction in the referral document is scoped to the pre-check before providing the referral tool: no documented referral program for the requested card, customer's cited terms don't match any documented program, or reason to believe the referral will be automatically rejected — in which case the agent explains why and does not provide the referral link tool and does not transfer. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_009]

For status REJECTED (rolling-limit denial) the agent should not retry immediately and should review the user's existing referral activity before advising next steps; for status ERROR the agent should retry later or escalate internally if the condition persists. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_001]

No appeal, override, or manual-reinstatement process exists for credit-card referral denials; the only remedy for a rolling-window auto-denial is waiting for older bonuses to age out of the 7-day window. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_002]

The only referral-investigation language found in any referral document is card-specific and business-oriented: if a referral does not appear, the customer is told to contact support with the referred business name and application date so it can be investigated; no consumer credit-card referral equivalent or named team is documented. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_013]

proposed_arguments.summary:
Verified customer Wei Chen (user_id 76ad9cc60e; email wei.chen.boston@gmail.com; phone 617-555-0834; verification logged 2025-11-14 03:40:00 EST) reports making four credit card referrals over roughly a month but receiving only two bonuses. He asks for a per-referral determination — for each of the four friends, whether the bonus is denied/gone or still pending — along with the referral statuses and bonus timestamps.

What was attempted: I searched the knowledge base twice for an internal agent tool that lists a customer's credit card referral records, per-referral status, denial reason codes, and bonus timestamps. The KB confirms no such agent-facing tool exists; the only documented referral tool is the customer-run get_referral_link(user_id, card_name), which creates a NO_PROGRESS record and is not a lookup tool. Referral status is otherwise customer-visible only in the app referral dashboard.

I explained the documented program rules: a rolling cap of 2 credit card referral bonuses per 7-day window across all card types, evaluated on exact bonus timestamps rather than signup dates (so referrals spread over a month can still collide), plus per-card annual caps (typically 7 consumer / 8-11 business) and non-payment triggers (applying before the link, not approved, qualifying spend of 60-135 days not met, returns/cash equivalents reducing spend, account not in good standing). Status semantics: REJECTED = rolling-limit denial, COMPLETE = bonus granted, IN_PROGRESS/APPLIED = still pending, NO_PROGRESS = no application started via link, ERROR = system issue.

I asked the customer to read the four statuses from his app dashboard so I could interpret them against the specific card terms. He declined, explaining he called precisely because he lacks access to anyone who can interpret those internal records, and requested transfer to someone who can see the referral records and bonus timestamps and give him a per-friend answer. Two KB searches for a referral-specific escalation path or specialized rewards team returned nothing, so the generic human transfer is the documented route.

Note for the receiving agent: the KB documents no appeal or manual-reinstatement process for rolling-cap referral denials, so if two of the four are REJECTED under the 7-day cap, the customer may need that expectation set directly.

Referral status REJECTED means the user has too many referral processes going on (i.e., the rolling limit was hit); on REJECTED the agent should not retry immediately and should review the user's existing referral activity before advising next steps. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_001]

Referral status definitions: COMPLETE = criteria met and bonus granted per program terms; IN_PROGRESS = account opened, working toward criteria; APPLIED = awaiting decision; NO_PROGRESS = no application started; ERROR = system error (retry later or escalate internally if persistent). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_001]

A customer can receive at most 2 credit card referral bonuses in any rolling 7-day window; the third and any subsequent referrals in that window are automatically denied, and the cap applies across all credit card types. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_002]
The rolling 7-day window is evaluated on the exact timestamps of the referrer's most recent successful referral bonuses, not calendar weeks. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_002]

Auto-denied referrals due to the rolling limit cannot be reinstated within the same 7-day window; the referrer must wait until enough time passes to drop under the cap (older bonuses age out) before attempting another referral. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_002]

No appeal, override, or manual-reinstatement process for credit card referral denials is documented; the only documented remedy is waiting for the rolling window to clear. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_002]

Referral status can be tracked by the customer in the Rho-Bank mobile app (referral dashboard / rewards section), and the customer is notified when referrals are approved and when a bonus is earned; agents can also field referral questions via customer service. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_020]

Before giving referral information the agent must confirm the specific card has a documented referral program; if none is documented, the user's stated terms don't match, or the referral would be auto-rejected, the agent explains why and does NOT provide the referral link tool and does not transfer to a human. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_009]

Each credit card type has its own referral bonus amount and eligibility requirements; the general credit card referral document does not enumerate them, so per-card terms must be checked in the card-specific referral documents. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_002]

For comparison, the analogous checking-account referral FAQ states rejection reasons explicitly (rolling window limit, existing/recent account, same address, same business primary owner) and directs ineligible users to wait until the oldest qualifying referral ages out of the window — but that document governs checking accounts, not credit cards. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_048]

The documented internal pattern for retrieving a per-user history list (get_user_dispute_history_7291(user_id), returning statuses, dates, reason_code, outcome, internal notes) exists for credit card disputes only; no equivalent referral-history tool is documented. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_016]

The KB documents no internal agent tool for retrieving or inspecting a customer's credit card referral records, per-referral status, or denial reasons; searches returned only the customer-facing get_referral_link tool and unrelated history tools (dispute history, CLI/payment history, closure-reason history). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_009]

Referral status can be tracked by the customer in the Rho-Bank mobile app / referral dashboard, and the customer is notified when referrals are approved and when a bonus is earned; questions about the referral program or current card offer are directed to the customer service team (1-800-RHO-BANK). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_020]

Transfers to humans are performed with the transfer_to_human_agents tool, and the reason code must be selected from a documented 4-tier list, always choosing from the highest tier that applies. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042]
TIER 2 is labeled 'Knowledge/Capability Gap Reasons' and is to be used when the transfer is due to the agent's inability to find or verify information. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042]

The Tier 2 code kb_search_unsuccessful_customer_requests_transfer is defined as: customer asked for information or instructions that you searched for in KB but couldn't find, you informed the customer, customer then requests transfer. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042]

The Tier 2 code specialized_department_required is defined as: request requires a specialized department (mortgage, investments, business banking) outside the agent's scope of knowledge/tools. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042]
The Tier 1 code technical_system_error is defined as: system error or outage preventing completion of the customer's request. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042]
The Tier 4 catch-all code other requires a detailed explanation in the summary field. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042]

The 'do not transfer to a human' instruction in the referral document is scoped to the pre-check before providing the referral tool: no documented referral program for the requested card, customer's cited terms don't match any documented program, or reason to believe the referral will be automatically rejected — in which case the agent explains why and does not provide the referral link tool and does not transfer. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_009]

For status REJECTED (rolling-limit denial) the agent should not retry immediately and should review the user's existing referral activity before advising next steps; for status ERROR the agent should retry later or escalate internally if the condition persists. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_001]

No appeal, override, or manual-reinstatement process exists for credit-card referral denials; the only remedy for a rolling-window auto-denial is waiting for older bonuses to age out of the 7-day window. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_002]

The special staged transfer protocol using the internal discoverable tool initial_transfer_to_human_agent_0218 applies only to customers reporting credit card purchase declines despite available credit (first three requests use that tool, the fourth uses transfer_to_human_agents). The other staged transfer protocol (initial_transfer_to_human_agent_1822 then initial_transfer_to_human_agent_0218, then transfer_to_human_agents on the third request) applies only to the 11/13 backend payment-posting incident and only until 11/15/2025 11:59 PM EST. open_questions: The name, parameters, and unlock/call procedure for an internal agent tool that lists a customer's credit card referral records (status, card, timestamps, bonus amount) — not documented in the KB.

Whether any denied credit-card referral bonus can be appealed, manually re-credited, or issued as a goodwill statement credit — no documented appeal path; apply_statement_credit_8472 reasons are not tied to referral denials.
Whether agents have any internal view mirroring the customer's app referral dashboard, or whether the customer must read the dashboard values to the agent.

No documented SLA, response time, or expected turnaround for a human agent handling a referral-records investigation.
